1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.Nf3 Nc6 5.Nb.strategy: Asks the bishop to decide at once: it must trade itself off or retreat. Either way White keeps the pawn structure intact, and a trade costs Black the bishop pair.

Cashes in the bishop before it is chased. The recapture brings the knight back to f3, where it still guards e5 and attacks the wedge, but White has the bishop pair and Black must prove the pawn is worth it.
